title: Process Kill Proof Gate
desc: Harness reflex that blocks OS process termination until command line working directory parent and owner are verified.
steps: TRIGGER: Before any Stop-Process, taskkill, kill, or process termination command. ACTION: Stop and run wktasklist -V or tasklist with full command lines, then verify PID, image, command line, working directory, parent PID, and owner against the intended session.
BLOCK: If any identity field is missing, inaccessible, or mismatched, do not terminate. Return a named proof-missing refusal and ask for owner approval.
SCOPE: Never infer repository ownership from process name, PID, start time, CPU, or memory alone. Different repositories can run identical Codex image names.
SAFE ROUTE: Prefer a dry-run classified wkappbot taskkill path. Force termination is allowed only after the dry-run names the exact target and the proof matches.
EVIDENCE: After termination, re-run the process inventory and record the exact PID, command line, working directory, and exit result.
NAVIGATION: Read harness-process-kill-proof-gate-howto for the procedure and harness-process-kill-proof-gate-ref for the incident record.
